provenance.extraction: Exact prompt prefix before the preliminary instruction; copy_record and initial_answer reasoning-first requests verified identical. No world generation or historical responses.

json_instruction: Output only a JSON object with the fields "first_value", "reasoning", and "final_answer". Write your reasoning in "reasoning". Set "final_answer" to A, B, or C. Your final answer may match or differ from the preliminary entry.

entry_instructions.copy_record: Copy the target vehicle's Verified class cell exactly into first_value. Treat this entry as the recorded class.
entry_instructions.initial_answer: Give your initial answer to the class question in first_value.
